question: LPG is stored in small cylinders under high pressure because ___________.

options.text: Gas turns into liquid form, requiring less space for storage
It burns easily at normal temperature
Gas cannot be stored in cylinders

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gas turns into liquid form, requiring less space for storage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) is stored under high pressure in cylinders, which causes the gas to liquefy.
 
• This liquefaction significantly reduces the volume, making storage and transportation more efficient.
 
• Liquefied form of LPG allows for a larger amount of energy to be stored in a small space.
 
• High pressure is necessary to maintain LPG in its liquid state at room temperature.
 
• This practice ensures the availability of LPG for domestic and industrial use in a safe and manageable manner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Properties of LPG:**

 
 
• LPG is a mixture of hydrocarbon gases, primarily propane and butane.
 
• It is colorless and odorless in its natural state, but an odorant is added for leak detection.
 
• LPG has a high calorific value, making it an efficient source of energy.
 
 
 
• **Uses of LPG:**
 
 
• Commonly used as fuel for cooking in households.
 
• Used in heating appliances, hot water systems, and as fuel in internal combustion engines.
 
• Widely used in industrial processes and as a feedstock in the chemical industry.
 
 
 
• **Safety Measures:**
 
 
• Cylinders are designed to withstand high pressure and are equipped with safety valves to release excess pressure.
 
• Proper storage and handling are crucial to prevent accidents and ensure safe usage.
 
• Regular checks and maintenance of LPG cylinders and connections are necessary for safety.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact:**
 
 
• LPG burns more cleanly compared to other fossil fuels, producing fewer pollutants and greenhouse gases.
 
• It is considered a more environmentally friendly option for heating and cooking.
